title: AI validation-readiness triage — structured-element output (v1)
description: One object per screened record. Two model families each produce one of these objects per record_id; no eligibility/advance-exclude decision is included. Element values are structured-element extractions, not screening dispositions.

quote.description: Verbatim substring copied from the supplied title/abstract, <=25 words, or "" if the value is absent/unclear and no supporting text exists. Never paraphrase. Never include text that is not in the supplied title/abstract.

record_id.description: Echo of the input record_id exactly as supplied (e.g. FS-000123).

E1_exercise_exposure.description: core_A = identifiable single exercise bout (any intensity/mode). support_B = repeated identified bouts in the same people. chronic_training_only = a training programme with no bout-linked sampling. habitual_or_resting_cross_sectional = habitual-activity or resting cross-sectional comparison. none_or_non_exercise = no exercise exposure, or a non-exercise exposure (drug/diet/disease/sleep/etc). unclear = abstract does not let this be judged.

E2_post_exercise_sampling.description: present = at least one biosample taken after cessation of an identified bout, at any time point including 'immediately after' and including samples only at/after 1 week. absent = only pre-exercise/during-exercise samples, or only resting samples with no bout-linked post-cessation draw. unclear = cannot be judged from the abstract.

marker_families.description: Named immune/inflammatory/immune-relevant-omics marker families mentioned (e.g. 'leukocyte subsets', 'NK cells', 'cytokines', 'sIgA', 'CRP', 'immunoglobulins', 'complement', 'proteomics', 'transcriptomics'). Empty array if value is absent or unclear.

E3_immune_marker.description: A named immune, inflammatory, or immune-relevant omics marker measured in a human biosample.

E4_population.description: Report only what the abstract states; do NOT apply the mean-2SD age rule yourself. adults_stated = explicit adult age range/minimum, or clearly adult descriptor with numeric support. young_adult_age_unclear = only mean+/-SD or vague 'young/students/athletes' given, no explicit range/minimum. includes_under_18 = abstract states participants <18y were included. clinical_or_infected_cohort = abstract states a disease/active-infection cohort. animal_or_in_vitro = non-human. unclear = cannot be judged.

subtypes.description: May be empty. metric_validation = reliability/reproducibility/intra-or-inter-individual variability/CV/reference intervals/thresholds-cutoffs/diagnostic-or-predictive performance/minimal detectable change. outcome_linkage = marker linked to infection/URTI/URS/illness/overtraining-overreaching/performance decrement. omics_discovery = proteomics/metabolomics/transcriptomics/miRNA/epigenomics/single-cell/EV-exosome profiling. repeated_monitoring = same marker tracked across >=2 bouts/competitions or a season in the same individuals.

note.description: <=30 words, free text, no personal data, no e-mail.
